target_customer: Companies that need structured data from hundreds or thousands of websites
problem: Web scrapers break and need custom code per site; Reworkd's agents generate and maintain extraction code at scale. Originally the product let users run autonomous LLM agents in a browser.
business_model: Managed web data extraction service, sold through a pilot program (pricing not found)
product_category: AI agents, then web data extraction

founders.name: Srijan Subedi
education: University of British Columbia, combined major in science

founders.name: Asim Shrestha
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in the company seed post; search snippets call him CEO, unverified. Other founders such as Adam Watkins appear in secondary coverage only.

investors: AI Grant (Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross)

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable LLM agents that traverse sites, generate extraction code and validate output at scale were frontier engineering in 2023 and 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Agent frameworks were open source and models improved quickly; the managed extraction service had limited lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of incumbents buying or copying Reworkd; the company later sunset its extraction product on February 6, 2025 per its own site.

market_need_then: AgentGPT drew over 30,000 GitHub stars and over a million users per the YC page, and the company said web scraping was a popular use of it.

branding.domain_note: Uses reworkd.ai; domain history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual developer voice: 'It's time to do data different'

branding.brand_signature: AgentGPT, the open-source browser agent product that drew the community
branding.community_and_virality: AgentGPT reached roughly 30,000 to 36,000 GitHub stars depending on the source and was a Show HN and YC launch.

brand_strength.rationale: The AgentGPT product name carried more awareness than the company name Reworkd; the community did not transfer to the extraction product.

pivots.from: AgentGPT and general autonomous AI agents
pivots.to: AI agents that extract web data at scale
pivots.why: Per TechCrunch headline and a seed post, scraping was a popular AgentGPT use case; the TechCrunch article text itself was not opened.

pivots.to: Product sunset with no stated successor
pivots.why: The company site says the product sunsets on February 6, 2025; cause not stated.

outcome_analysis: Reworkd rode the 2023 autonomous agent boom with AgentGPT, raised a $1.25M pre-seed in July 2023 and a $2.75M seed in July 2024 after pivoting to web scraping agents. Its own site later announced the product would sunset on February 6, 2025, and the AgentGPT repository was reported archived in 2026, so the extraction pivot did not hold. The reasons are not public. Status in the YC directory remains Active.
notes: Pre-seed reported as CAD 1.65M by BetaKit and USD 1.25M in the company post (consistent). Seed amount $2.75M per the company post and CB Insights; some aggregators say $3M. Archive date for AgentGPT repository (January 2026) is from secondary sites only. Cause of the sunset is not public, so failure factors are inferences from the timeline and should be treated as low confidence. YC lists team size 1 and status Active despite the sunset notice. No competitor source dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty. The company says total funding was over $4M after the seed.
